posts.content:
Here's a free DR 60 backlink if your product is built with Vue. ~4.9K organic visits/mo.

1. Open https://madewithvuejs.com/submit (no account)
2. Add title, description, tech stack and URL
3. Add your GitHub repo
4. Pass the spam check and submit

Catch: Vue only, 6 to 8 week review.
posts.author: Rapid Indexer - Fastest Indexing Tool
posts.notes: 在 madewithvuejs.com 打开提交页（无需账号），添加标题、描述、技术栈和 URL，加上 GitHub 仓库，通过 spam check 提交，得到 DR60 外链（仅限 Vue 产品，审核 6-8 周）。

posts.content:
I get 5-10 backlinks a month without sending a single outreach email.

My method:
- Pick a topic many businesses need data on
- Skip it if Google's top 10 is full of stats roundups (too crowded)
- Trace every stat to its original report
- Publish one page writers can cite
posts.author: Prosper Noah
posts.notes: 选一个许多企业需要数据的主题，避开已被统计综述占领的关键词，追溯每个数据到原始报告，发布一页可被引用的内容页，每月得到 5-10 个外链且无需发送 outreach。

posts.content:
Earned beats pitched.

Journalists on HARO, Terkel, Connectively need expert quotes daily. Answer fast, be specific ("in our campaigns, X saw Y"), sign with a real bio — and get cited with a link money can't buy.

#SEO #LinkBuilding
posts.author: Nadir Pitafi
posts.notes: 在 HARO、Terkel、Connectively 上快速回答记者查询，提供具体案例数字并签名真实 bio，得到被引用的编辑外链。
